# Md. Shakibur Rahaman - 360° Creative Director & Digital Growth Architect

> Full-Stack Creative Director delivering integrated visual design, web engineering, omnichannel marketing, and live experiential activations.

## 8 Core Service Pillars
1. **Graphics Design**: Brand identity, logo marks, UI/UX, luxury packaging, marketing collateral.
2. **Web Design & Development**: 15+ live web portals, headless e-commerce, custom web apps, 95+ PageSpeed.
3. **Social Media Marketing (SMM)**: Omnichannel strategy, viral short-form video reels, community growth, Meta Advantage+.
4. **Photoshoot & Videography**: Commercial TVCs, cinematic product shoots, brand documentaries, high-retention video reels.
5. **Event Activation & Exhibition**: 3D booth design, B2B trade show installations, corporate galas, experiential activations.
6. **Google Ads**: High-intent Search, Performance Max, YouTube conversion funnels, multi-touch attribution.
7. **SEO & AEO**: Technical on-page SEO, generative AI engine optimization (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini).
8. **PR (Public Relations)**: Mainstream press release distribution, tier-1 media placements, crisis communications, thought leadership.

## Official Contact & Representation
- **Name**: Md. Shakibur Rahaman
- **Email**: shakibur188@gmail.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +880 1838-070468
- **Location**: Dhaka, Bangladesh
